### Lumen — Work, illuminated
Lumen is an Infinite spatial canvas for organizing work through free-form kanban structures and arbitrary task objects.
FOSS & Local-first engine with durable offline storage and deterministic state for high-fidelity personal workflow.
With optional team layer providing realtime sync, shared workspaces, and governed collaboration.

Available on : [lumen](https://canvas.itssingularity.com) | [landing](https://lumen.itssingularity.com)
